package dailyassignments;

public class Program1_ASCII {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		
	/*
	 * Assignment 1: ASCII Code Program
		Question:
		Write a Java program to print the ASCII value of the following characters:
		•	A 
		•	a 
		•	0 
		•	@ 
		Expected Output:
		ASCII value of A = 65
		ASCII value of a = 97
		ASCII value of 0 = 48
		ASCII value of @ = 64
		
	 */
		
		char chA='A';
		int numA=chA;
		System.out.println("ASCII value of A = "+numA);
		
		
		char cha='a';
		int numa=cha;
		System.out.println("ASCII value of a = "+numa);

		char cha0='0';
		int value=cha0;
		System.out.println("ASCII value of 0 = "+value);
		
		char chspecial ='@';
		int ans=chspecial;
		System.out.println("ASCII value of 0 = "+ans);

	}

}
